why: Серия «Балкон под ключ», формула «балкон как лучшая комната дома»: ролик «балкон + пергола» набрал 47 359 просмотров. Цель — заявки на консультацию и замер на месте.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames at 5.5s and 7.7s are near-identical (same balcony facade with the same crop), so the video looks static there
Frames at 9.9s and 12.1s are near-identical (same glazed tower), another repeat
The first frame shows a plain facade with a tiny balcony, no pergola and no clear glass work, so the hook is weak
The pergola frame at 3.3s is mostly a wooden slatted structure and a pool terrace, with little glass work visible
The captions are chopped into fragments (безрамное, консультируем и, договоримся о) and do not match the pictures
qa.fix: Replace the repeated balcony shots with varied close-ups of frameless glass panels sliding, a pergola with glass, and a measuring visit, open on a strong pergola-plus-glazing shot, and use full-phrase captions.
